Dear Farmer Group,

We have completed our investigation of claim CLM-LAG-2025-002 under policy POL-LAG-2025-015 for maize.

The reference rain gauge at Murtala Muhammed (NIM00065201) was unreliable during the cover window (1–31 July 2025). It reported on only 10 of 31 days (32% coverage, below the 80% minimum), was silent for 21 days when the satellite recorded 109.8 mm of rain, and on the 10 days both sources reported the gauge totalled 6.1 mm versus the satellite's 21.9 mm.

Because the gauge record fails our quality checks, the claim was settled using the satellite index (NASA POWER) for your farm location (6.577°N, 3.321°E). The satellite recorded 131.65 mm for July 2025, which falls within the historical range of 117–417 mm observed over the past 24 years.

This rainfall amount lies between the policy's exit threshold (61.8 mm) and full trigger (144.3 mm), so a partial payout applies. The approved payout is NGN 276,000.

The payout will be processed shortly. We have also notified the station operator about the gauge's repeated outages.

Yours sincerely,
Pluvia Claims
